grid.label: Worksheet {sheet}

grid.cut: Cut {ref}. Paste at the target cell to move the cells.
grid.cutEnded: The cut ended. The cells stay where they are.
grid.copyUnmarked: The copied cells are no longer marked.

formulaBar.nameBoxHint: Type a cell, a range, or a defined name, such as B2 or Sheet2!B2:C5, then press Enter.
formulaBar.contentHint: Type a value, or a formula that starts with =. Press Enter to apply, Alt+Enter for a new line, or Escape to cancel.
formulaBar.shortened: This field shows only the start of the text.
formulaBar.shortenedEdit: Press F2 in the grid to edit the cell. The edit applies only when the text is not too long for one cell.

zoom.resetAt: Reset the zoom to 100%. The zoom is {level}.

status.empty: Open a workbook to show it here.
status.stale: Formula results can be out of date: the editor shows the stored results and does not recalculate them.
status.staleShort: Formula results can be out of date.
status.protected: This sheet is protected. Locked cells and locked actions cannot be edited.
status.viewWaits: View mode starts when you commit or cancel the cell edit.
status.viewWaitsShort: View mode waits for the cell edit.
status.conditionalHidden: This sheet has conditional formatting that the grid can leave out. Where it does, a cell can show its own format or the format of another rule. A save keeps every rule.
status.conditionalHiddenShort: The grid can leave out some conditional formatting.

failed.package: This file is not a workbook that the editor can open.
failed.fonts: The fonts that show the workbook did not load.
failed.noWorksheet: This workbook has no worksheet to show.
failed.tooLarge: This file is too large or too complex to open here. It passes the limit of {limit}.
failed.tooLargePart: This file is too large or too complex to open here. The part {part} passes the limit of {limit}.
failed.smallerCopy: Try a smaller copy, for example one with fewer rows or sheets.

limits.zipMaxRatio: a compression ratio of 200, which applies above 8 MiB of content
limits.workbookMaxSheetNameLength: 32,767 UTF-16 code units in one sheet name

pastLimit.styles: The part {part} is too large or too complex to show, so every cell shows the default format. On a sheet that is not protected, Paste, Clear formats, and Clear all give the default format. Every other format change is refused. A save keeps the part as it is.
pastLimit.theme: The part {part} is too large or too complex to show, so the theme colors and fonts do not apply. A save keeps the part as it is.
pastLimit.drawing: The part {part} is too large or too complex to show, so its pictures do not show. Rows and columns of its sheet cannot be inserted, deleted, or resized. A save keeps the part as it is.
pastLimit.relationships: The part {part} is too large or too complex to show, so the parts that it links to do not show. A save keeps the part as it is.
pastLimit.other: The part {part} is too large or too complex to show. The workbook does not use it, so no cell depends on it. A save keeps the part as it is.
pastLimit.more: {count, plural, one {# other part is} other {# other parts are}} also too large or too complex to show.
pastLimit.short: A part of the workbook is too large or too complex to show.

editing.decimalsUnchanged: The decimal places were not changed. {reason}
editing.resizeUnreadDrawing: The size was not applied: the editor cannot read the drawing of this sheet, so it cannot check the objects on it.

refused.unknown-sheet: The edit was not applied: the sheet does not exist.
refused.bad-reference: The edit was not applied: the cell, row, or column is outside the sheet.
refused.bad-value: The edit was not applied: the value cannot be stored in a cell.
refused.text-too-long: The edit was not applied: the text is too long for one cell. Shorten the text, then try again.
refused.bad-size: The size was not applied: use a column width from 0 to 255 characters, or a row height from 0 to 409 points.
refused.merge-one-cell: The cells were not merged: select two or more cells, then try again.
refused.merge-overlap: The cells were not merged: the selection overlaps the merged range {subject}. Unmerge it first, or select another range.
refused.merge-drops-values: The cells were not merged: cells other than the top-left cell hold values, such as {subject}. A merge keeps only the value of the top-left cell, so clear those cells first.
refused.bad-position: The sheet was not added or moved: the position is outside the sheet list.
refused.invalid-sheet: The edit was not applied: the sheet has a cell structure that the editor cannot change safely.
refused.shared-formula: The edit was not applied: it would change the formula range at {subject}, which the editor cannot rewrite or remove. Edit another cell.
refused.unreadable-formula: The formula was not applied: it cannot be read. Check the quotes, parentheses, and references.
refused.formula-syntax: The formula was not applied: it has an operator, a value, or a separator in the wrong place.
refused.r1c1-formula: The formula was not applied: it uses R1C1 references. Use A1 references, such as B2.
refused.unsupported-function: The formula was not applied: the editor cannot write a call to {subject}. Use a predefined function.
refused.unknown-formula-reference: The formula was not applied: it names a sheet, a linked workbook, or a table that this workbook does not have. Put a sheet name with spaces in single quotes, such as 'My sheet'!A1.
refused.invalid-character: The edit was not applied: the text has a control character that a workbook cannot store.
refused.unsupported-package: The edit was not applied: the workbook has a part that the editor cannot change.
refused.cell-alternate-content: The edit was not applied: cell {subject} holds data in a form that the editor cannot update. The editor cannot change the value of that cell. Edit another cell.
refused.bad-format: The format was not applied: a format value is outside its allowed values.
refused.unreadable-number-format: The format was not applied: the number format code cannot be read.
refused.range-too-large: The edit was not applied: it would add more than {limit} cells to the sheet. Select or paste a smaller range, such as one whole row.
refused.clear-too-large: The formats were not cleared: clearing them would add more than {limit} cells to the sheet. Select a smaller range, such as one whole row.
refused.decimals-too-large: The decimal places were not changed: the selection holds more than {limit} cells. Select fewer cells.
refused.decimals-unchanged: The decimal places were not changed: no selected cell has a number format whose decimal places can change.
refused.style-limit: The edit was not applied: the workbook holds too many cell formats.
refused.invalid-part: The edit was not applied: it would leave the workbook invalid.
refused.locked: The edit was not applied: the sheet is protected, and the cell is locked.
refused.structure-blocked: The edit was not applied: {subject} can refer to content that the edit changes, and the editor cannot update that reference.
refused.sheet-range-blocked: The sheet was not moved or deleted: {subject} refers to a range of sheets, such as Sheet1:Sheet3!A1, and the edit can change that range. Change that reference first.
refused.grid-full: The edit was not applied: {subject} would move past the last row or column of the sheet.
refused.stale-revision: The edit was not applied: the workbook changed while the edit was prepared. Try the edit again.
refused.save-failed: The workbook was not saved: the editor could not build the saved workbook. Your edits stay on this page.
refused.sheet-name-invalid: The sheet name was not applied. Use 1 to 31 characters. Do not use [ ] : * ? / \ or a control character such as a tab or a line break. Do not use a character that a workbook cannot store, or an escape sequence such as _x0041_. Do not start or end the name with an apostrophe.
refused.sheet-name-too-long: The edit was not applied: a sheet name is too long. Rename the sheet {subject} to 31 characters or fewer, then try again.
refused.sheet-name-taken: The sheet name was not applied: another sheet, possibly a hidden one, has the name {subject}.
refused.sheet-name-ambiguous: The edit was not applied: two sheets have the name {subject}, also when case is ignored, so a reference cannot tell them apart. Rename one of them first.
refused.last-sheet: The sheet was not deleted: a workbook must keep one visible sheet.
refused.not-editable: The edit was not applied: no workbook is open for editing.
refused.whole-sheet: The rows or columns were not inserted or deleted: the whole sheet is selected. Select whole rows, whole columns, or a range of cells.
refused.merged-range: The cells were not copied or pasted: the range meets a merged range. Select a range with no merged cells, then try again.
refused.paste-html: The paste was not applied: the clipboard holds only formatted content. Copy the content as plain text, then paste again.
refused.copy-too-large: The range was not copied: it has too many cells. Copy at most {limit} cells, such as one whole row.
refused.copy-conditional-limit: The range was not copied: it has more conditional formatting than one copy can check. Copy a smaller range, then try again.
refused.copy-array-formula: The range was not copied: it meets the array formula or data table at {subject}. Copy a range without cells of that range.

refused.cut-expired: The paste was not applied: the workbook changed after the cut. Cut the cells again, then paste.

refused.paste-name-scope: The paste was not applied: the formula from {subject} uses a name or a function that only one of the two sheets has. Paste on the source sheet.
refused.paste-reference-outside: The paste was not applied: a reference of the formula copied from {subject} would point outside the sheet. Paste at another cell.
refused.too-many-rows: The row height was not applied: the selection has too many rows with no content or size. Select fewer rows.
refused.resize-anchor: The size was not applied: {subject} keeps its size or position, and the resize would change it.
refused.view-mode: The edit was not applied: the workbook is open for viewing.
refused.composing: The command was not applied: finish the text that the input method composes first.
refused.edit-pending: The command was not applied: commit or cancel the cell edit first.
refused.edit-dropped: The open cell edit was dropped: its text was not stored.

hint.conditionalFormat: Conditional formatting changes how this cell shows. This control reads and sets the cell format.
hint.decimalsLargeSelection: The other format controls cannot change a selection this large. This control changes only the selected cells that hold numbers.

disabledReason.notWired: This control is not connected to an editor command.
disabledReason.editPending: Commit or cancel the cell edit first.
disabledReason.rangeTooLarge: The selection is too large to format. Select at most one whole row of cells.
disabledReason.clearTooLarge: The selection is too large to clear formats from. Select at most one whole row of cells.
disabledReason.structureBlocked: Rows and columns cannot be inserted or deleted: {subject} can refer to cells that would move, and the editor cannot move such a reference.
disabledReason.structureBlockedUnnamed: Content in this workbook can refer to cells that would move, and the editor cannot move such a reference.
disabledReason.structureUnavailable: This sheet has a cell structure that the editor cannot change safely.
disabledReason.wholeSheet: The whole sheet is selected. Select whole rows, whole columns, or a range of cells.
disabledReason.noSave: Saving is not set up for this editor.
disabledReason.viewMode: The workbook is open for viewing.
disabledReason.locked: The sheet is protected, and a cell in the selection is locked.
disabledReason.cellAlternateContent: The editor cannot clear cell {subject}. That cell holds data in a form that the editor cannot update. Select a range without that cell.
disabledReason.cellAlternateContentClearAll: The editor cannot clear cell {subject}. That cell holds data in a form that the editor cannot update. To remove only the formats, use Clear formats.
disabledReason.formulaRange: The editor cannot clear these cells: clearing them would change the formula range at {subject}, which the editor cannot rewrite or remove. Select a range without cells of that range.
disabledReason.formulaRangeClearAll: The editor cannot clear these cells: clearing them would change the formula range at {subject}, which the editor cannot rewrite or remove. To remove only the formats, use Clear formats.
disabledReason.formulaCell: The editor cannot clear the shared formula master {masterCell}: the formula of {causeCell} cannot be rewritten. Select a range without that master.
disabledReason.formulaCellClearAll: The editor cannot clear the shared formula master {masterCell}: the formula of {causeCell} cannot be rewritten. To remove only the formats, use Clear formats.
disabledReason.formulaUnreadable: The editor cannot clear the shared formula master {masterCell}: its formula cannot be read. Select a range without that master.
disabledReason.formulaUnreadableClearAll: The editor cannot clear the shared formula master {masterCell}: its formula cannot be read. To remove only the formats, use Clear formats.
disabledReason.formatLocked: The sheet is protected, and formatting cells is not allowed.
disabledReason.stylesUnread: The styles part of the workbook is too large or too complex to show, so only the default format can be given. On a sheet that is not protected, use Clear formats or Clear all.
disabledReason.stylesUnreadProtected: The styles part of the workbook is too large or too complex to show, and the sheet is protected, so the formats cannot be cleared. The protection of each cell is in that part.
disabledReason.structureLocked: The sheet is protected, and inserting or deleting rows or columns is not allowed.
disabledReason.workbookLocked: The workbook is protected, and adding, renaming, deleting, or moving sheets is not allowed.
disabledReason.lastSheet: The sheet cannot be deleted: a workbook must keep one visible sheet.
disabledReason.notWorksheet: This sheet is not a worksheet, or its part is missing. The editor cannot show, rename, delete, or move it.
disabledReason.sheetEditBlocked: Sheets cannot be renamed or deleted: {subject} can refer to any sheet, and the editor cannot update that reference.
disabledReason.composing: Finish the text that the input method composes first.
disabledReason.decimalsNoNumberSelection: No selected cell holds a number, so there are no decimal places to change.
disabledReason.decimalsNoNumber: This cell does not hold a number, so it has no decimal places to change.
disabledReason.decimalsNoShownPlaces: This cell shows no decimal places to remove.
disabledReason.decimalsGeneralSection: This number format has a General section, which has no fixed decimal places. Choose an entry in the number format list first.
disabledReason.decimalsGeneralSectionSelection: The number format of a selected cell has a General section, which has no fixed decimal places. Choose an entry in the number format list first.
disabledReason.decimalsDate: This number format shows a date or a time. The editor does not change its decimal places.
disabledReason.decimalsDateSelection: A selected cell shows a date or a time. The editor does not change its decimal places.
disabledReason.decimalsText: This number format shows text in place of a number, so it has no decimal places to change.
disabledReason.decimalsTextSelection: The number format of a selected cell shows text in place of a number, so it has no decimal places to change.
disabledReason.decimalsFraction: This number format shows a fraction, which has no decimal places to change.
disabledReason.decimalsFractionSelection: A selected cell shows a fraction, which has no decimal places to change.
disabledReason.decimalsNoDecimals: This number format has no decimal places to remove.
disabledReason.decimalsNoDecimalsSelection: No selected cell shows decimal places to remove.
disabledReason.decimalsNoDecimalsCellSelection: A selected cell shows no decimal places to remove.
disabledReason.decimalsMaxDecimals: This number format already has the most decimal places that the editor writes: {limit}.
disabledReason.decimalsMaxDecimalsSelection: No selected number format can take another decimal place: the editor writes at most {limit}.
disabledReason.decimalsMaxDecimalsCellSelection: A selected cell already has the most decimal places that the editor writes: {limit}.
disabledReason.decimalsTooLong: The number format code would be longer than {limit} characters.
disabledReason.decimalsTooLongSelection: The new number format code of a selected cell would be longer than {limit} characters.
disabledReason.decimalsUnreadable: The editor cannot change the decimal places of this number format code.
disabledReason.decimalsUnreadableSelection: The editor cannot change the decimal places of the number format code of a selected cell.
disabledReason.decimalsNoCode: The editor does not know how this built-in number format shows numbers. Choose an entry in the number format list first.
disabledReason.decimalsNoCodeSelection: The editor does not know how the built-in number format of a selected cell shows numbers. Choose an entry in the number format list first.
disabledReason.decimalsMissingCode: The workbook does not define this number format. Choose an entry in the number format list first.
disabledReason.decimalsMissingCodeSelection: The workbook does not define the number format of a selected cell. Choose an entry in the number format list first.
disabledReason.decimalsTooLarge: The selection holds more than {limit} cells. Select fewer cells to change the decimal places.
disabledReason.mergeLocked: The sheet is protected, and cells cannot be merged or unmerged.
disabledReason.mergeOneCell: Select two or more cells to merge.
disabledReason.mergeOverlap: The selection overlaps a merged range. Unmerge it first, or select another range.
disabledReason.noMergedRange: The selection has no merged cells.
